project.name: Gimle Example: greeting-operator
project.description: A real, deployable operator module -- the controller half of the custom-kind pattern: an ordinary hosted module (deployed by manifest, tiered, probed, supervised like anything else, never control-plane code) whose onStart hook runs a GaldrOperatorLoop over kind custom.Greeting, saying each Greeting's message its declared number of times and reporting {timesSaid, observedGeneration} back as the resource's status through the agent-mediated, workload-identity-authorized status relay. The same requires-static posture greeter-provider documents applies to com.gimle.module and org.slf4j here.
